The announcement appeared to differ from Seoul’s position that only the Texas project has been finalized so far. US President Donald Trump makes an announcement with Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick in the Oval Office of the White House, Washington, Sept. 30. UPI-Yonhap

articles.titleJa: スポンサーシップを超えて、企業はスポーツにテクノロジーを提供します

articles.summaryOriginal: Companies are expanding sports sponsorships into technology, training and long-term support. SK Telecom has backed Korean fencing for 24 years and used AI at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Hyundai Motor Group has supported Korean archery since 1985 with engineering-based training tools, while other firms are widening sports partnerships across multiple events. South Korean fencers celebrate with the national flag after winning the women’s team sabre final against Japan at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games at Aichi Sky Expo in Tokoname, Japan, Sunday. Yonhap
